title: Settings
subtitle: How the app looks and sounds on this device, and what other people see of you.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: “System” follows whatever your device is set to, and changes with it.

language.title: Language
language.label: Display language
language.description: The language the app's own wording is shown in. A lesson is always shown in the language it was written in.
language.onlyOne: English is the only language available so far.

speech.title: Reading aloud
speech.description: Used by practice mode to read each step out. Everything is spoken by your own device — no lesson text is sent anywhere.

device.title: This device
device.installDescription: Keep Spelling Creator in your dock or on your home screen, and open lessons you've saved without a connection.
device.lessonsDescription: Lessons are drafted in this browser and stay here until you publish them. This is where you switch between them, rename one, or delete one.

account.title: Account
account.displayNameDescription: The name shown to other people, in place of your email.
account.bioDescription: A short “about me” on your public profile.
account.emailDescription: How you sign in. Never shown to other people.
account.signedOutDescription: Sign in to publish lessons, comment on other people's, and set up a profile. Everything above works signed out.
